asset_heavy.reason: Manufactures meters and sensors in plants, but growth is not driven by heavy fleets or networks; moderate manufacturing footprint.

big_ticket.reason: Water meters, sensors and software subscriptions are modest per-unit purchases, though AMI rollouts can be large projects.

cyclical_demand.reason: Municipal utilities buy water meters for replacement and compliance; demand is mostly non-discretionary, though industrial instrumentation is somewhat cyclical.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are municipal water utilities, plus commercial and industrial users; mostly local governments, not large enterprises.

notes: Large customers is borderline: municipal utilities are government but mostly local and varied in size.

offers_products.reason: Makes water meters, sensors, valves, and BlueEdge/OneNetwork software.

offers_services.reason: Services such as training and cellular data are tied to its products, not a main standalone offering.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured meters, sensors and software, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Utilities repeatedly buy meters and replacements, and pay recurring subscriptions for cellular and software; mostly repeat buying.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to utilities, commercial and industrial customers; households only use the meters, they don't choose them.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Municipal water utilities, data centers, industrial plants, universities and facility managers are its buyers.
